info.name: MSXPiNoROM
info.description: MSXPi interface with NO EPROM fitted: the I/O ports only. This is what msxpiext.asm exists for - the BASIC extension is BLOADed from disk and relocates itself into page-1 RAM, because there is no ROM at 0x4000 to provide CALL MSXPI. Used for testing that path under emulation.
